recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical cosmic composition featuring a central black sun or eclipse surrounded by a high-velocity radial starburst of red and orange streaks. Four chrome-textured, purple-hued biomechanical spacecraft or figures are arranged in a cross-formation, converging toward the center. The top is dominated by large, stylized chrome lettering with a heavy drop shadow.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial symmetry centered on a dark circular void
Contrast between organic-metallic purple forms and sharp linear red streaks
Dominant display typography integrated into the upper starburst field
Bright lens flare highlights against deep space blacks
coreInvariants: Radial motion lines extending to all four corners
Chrome-effect beveling on all foreground elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central black circle acts as the focal point; four spacecraft occupy the cardinal directions; large title text spans the upper third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central black eclipse with a bright white lens flare at its edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Explosive radial lines draw the eye from the edges to the center, while the vertical arrangement of the spacecraft leads the eye to the top title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense and active; negative space is filled with fine-line starburst patterns rather than empty black.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red and burnt orange (background starburst)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Metallic purple and cyan (spacecraft and text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white (lens flares and chrome highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds; high value contrast in the chrome reflections against the dark void.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, blocky sans-serif with geometric and futuristic modifications
letterConstructionRules: Letters feature a thick cyan outline with a metallic inner gradient
Sharp, angular terminals and exaggerated horizontal bars
Heavy red drop shadow creating a 3D 'pop' effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'T' has an elongated top bar that acts as a roof for adjacent letters
Circular letters like 'O' are perfectly geometric with thick strokes

composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated into the upper atmosphere of the scene

treatment.outline: Thin white inner, thick cyan outer

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A smaller, secondary row of blocky, stylized text sits immediately below the main title, using similar chrome effects but reduced scale.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the specific interlocking nature of the original art

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 1970s airbrushed sci-fi scene. Central black sun eclipse with a bright white lens flare. A high-speed radial starburst of red and orange lines explodes from the center. Four purple metallic biomechanical spacecraft are arranged symmetrically (top, bottom, left, right) pointing toward the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, custom-lettered display text at the top. Use a heavy blocky futuristic style with cyan chrome gradients and a deep red 3D drop shadow. Ensure the text feels integrated into the starburst.

verificationChecks: Do the spacecraft have a purple chrome reflection?
Is the text rendered with a 3D metallic effect?
Is the central void a solid black circle?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the purple hue on spacecraft
Width of the chrome bevel on the text
mustRedesign: Original brand logos in the corners
Exact character shapes of the unique hand-drawn title
postGenerationChecks: Verify the 3D extrusion direction of the text matches the starburst
Ensure the lens flare does not overpower the central black circle
Confirm the purple spacecraft have distinct biomechanical silhouettes
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Radial Starburst Background] + [Symmetrical Biomechanical Elements] + [Chrome Display Typography] with a [1970s Airbrush] filter.
